message.hollowtanvil.favor_granted: ❆ The Hollow Altar has granted its favor... ❆
message.hollowtanvil.choose_reward: ✦ The Hollow Altar offers three paths. Choose. ✦
message.hollowtanvil.power_hint: Press [Left Alt] to activate your power. (5s cooldown)
message.hollowtanvil.altar_too_close: ☠ The Hollow Altar rejects this location. Another altar is only %d blocks away (minimum: %d). ☠
message.hollowtanvil.altar_limit: ☠ The Hollow Altar refuses to serve. You already have %d altars — it will not share your blood. ☠
message.hollowtanvil.death_taunt_1: ☠ The Altar is disappointed. You were its champion... and you DIED? Pathetic. Powers revoked. ☠
message.hollowtanvil.death_taunt_2: ☠ Really? REALLY? The Altar invested its blood in you and you go and die. Powers: gone. Respect: also gone. ☠
message.hollowtanvil.death_taunt_3: ☠ The Altar watched you die and physically cringed. It's taking its powers back. Try not to embarrass it again. ☠
message.hollowtanvil.death_taunt_4: ☠ Congratulations! You managed to die. The Altar is rethinking its life choices. Powers confiscated. ☠
message.hollowtanvil.death_taunt_5: ☠ The Altar gave you LITERAL superpowers and you still died. It wants a refund. Powers revoked, altar reset. ☠
advancements.hollowtanvil.first_altar.de: You have awakened the Hollow Anvil. It demands sacrifice.
advancements.hollowtanvil.first_sacrific: The altar has tasted essence. It hungers for more.
advancements.hollowtanvil.blood_pact.des: The Hollow Altar has fulfilled its pact. Its hunger only grows.
advancements.hollowtanvil.blood_master.d: You have filled the altar to its very brim. It is sated... for now.
